decided: Design #244, before running stage 3 proof trials. Contrast thresholds are WCAG 2.2 AA (4.5:1 normal text, 3.0:1 large text >=24px or >=18.66px bold, 3.0:1 non-text UI per 1.4.11 with text-button fill exempt). Signal separation requires perceptual lightness separation >=0.08 and post-simulation Oklab distance >=0.08 under protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia. Spacing sits on the 8px base and is strictly monotonic. Type scale is strictly monotonic with a consistent ratio (spread <=0.08, step ratio 1.12..1.50), body >=16px, line height 1.20..1.45, and fallback font stacks of >=2 families. Never loosened to make a case pass.
